## Verification

- [ ] `./scripts/check-repository.ps1` passes, or exceptions are explained below.
- [ ] Relevant negative and failure-path tests are included.
- [ ] Assessment/schema and local-link validation pass.
- [ ] No secret, raw evidence, backup, real personal data, or generated output is committed.
- [ ] Documentation and acceptance traceability are updated.
- [ ] The diff contains no co-author trailers or fabricated review/approval records.

## Evidence and limitations

List commands executed, observed results, retained limitations, and any evidence IDs. Do not mark a
scenario finding resolved without a fresh retest.

## Self-review

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff.
- [ ] Secure defaults remain intact and exception scenarios remain bounded.
- [ ] Claims describe only work verified in this revision.
